name: opencircuitcore-sensor-node
description: OpenCircuitCore sensor-node: ESP32-S3-WROOM-1 with a BME280 on I2C, a 1x04 SENSOR header (J1) and a 1x06 PROG header (J2) on 2.54 mm pitch, four M3 holes. Designed in this platform; this entry exists so fixtures and enclosures can be checked against it (ADR-0007).

source.citation: Union of the per-component boxes of sensor-node.step (sha256 98d369a04085efc5c1ffa5b746c2afcecc2b9ad06f0bfb0d52311d8d18fb9eec) from scripts/extract_step_features.py, OCCT 7.9.3 (cadquery-ocp 7.9.3.1.1), 2026-11-06: z from the header pin tails at -1.405 to the pin tips at 10.135.

Per-component boxes of OpenCircuitCore's own STEP export 'sensor-node.step' (kicad-cli 10.0.5 pcb export step --subst-models, 2,522,235 bytes) computed 2026-11-06 by scripts/extract_step_features.py with OCCT 7.9.3 (cadquery-ocp 7.9.3.1.1); 12 components, byte-identical on repeat. The model is the design, not a vendor's drawing of a product: positions are exact by construction, and the built board differs from it only by assembly tolerance.

features.frame: The STEP model's own frame, unmodified: KiCad's board frame with y negated. x across the board (0 to 44, the edge nearer H1/H3 at x = 0); y along it, the antenna end at y = 0 and the header end at y = -52; z the board normal, z = 0 the bottom face and z = 1.6 the component face. Millimetres; the STEP declares MM.
not_modelled: The four M3 holes (3.2 mm NPTH at KiCad (3.5,17) (40.5,17) (3.5,48.5) (40.5,48.5), i.e. y negated here) are not items: they are absences in the Board box, listed under attributes.mounting_holes.
Solder fillets, the module's castellation solder and the header pins' solder joints on the z = 0 face are not in the STEP; only the header pin tails (to z = -1.405) are.
Cables or sockets plugged into J1 and J2: their housings' length is unknown (access depth_mm null).

access.source: TODO(source): the clearance Espressif requires around the WROOM-1 PCB antenna (ESP32-S3 Hardware Design Guidelines, antenna placement) is not pinned here. An antenna has no plug; what it needs is metal kept away, which a box of free air does not express. Unknown until cited.
